The geometry of the primary 4-5 rings is roughly circular with varying line thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is located on the lower posterior lateral flank. These asymmetrical blobs lack internal gradients and appear as concentrated, irregular patches with sharp edges against the darker background pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated, near-linear horizontal sequence with a slight downward convexity. Connecting these with the centroids of the dense lower-flank blobs creates a complex, irregular polygonal network of spatial relationships.
